name: Everlaw
description: Everlaw is a cloud-native e-discovery, investigations, litigation, legal hold, review, production, trial preparation, analytics, and AI platform for law firms, corporations, and government teams.
agentUseSummary: Everlaw is visible as a preview-only Marketplace entry. Everlaw publishes an API and regional technical documentation, but first-party support states that organization API keys are generated by Organization Admins, are equivalent to a password, can be valid for all API endpoints, and may cover broad endpoint categories including organizations, databases, projects, users, billing, source files, documents, review work, Deep Dive, audit events, analytics, legal holds, uploads, search, and metadata. Relay will not collect an Organization Admin API key or OAuth grant, choose deployment-specific endpoints, or mount any runtime tool until the exact organization approves a least-privilege V1 authority contract.

capabilities.label: Coordinate e-discovery operations
capabilities.description: Preview a future exact-organization-authorized, least-privilege integration surface without assuming access to organization, database, project, document, review, AI, legal hold, billing, or audit data.

blocked.label: Connect without an Everlaw organization contract
blocked.description: Relay will not accept API keys or OAuth credentials until the exact Everlaw organization authorizes Relay and supplies the approved region, organization, scopes or API-key endpoint permissions, fixed V1 authority endpoint, token/key lifecycle, audit obligations, test project, and production acceptance process.

blocked.label: Access identity, organization, database, or project data
blocked.description: Account identity, organizations, sub-organizations, databases, projects, users, groups, permissions, invitations, activity logs, events, project sizes, and billing records remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Access documents, review, AI, legal hold, or upload data
blocked.description: Datasets, source files, documents, metadata, search results, review work product, Deep Dive queries/results, legal holds, custodians, native uploads, productions, trial-prep materials, and related legal data remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use admin keys, OAuth, raw APIs, or region bypass
blocked.description: Organization Admin API keys, OAuth2 grants, passwords, browser sessions, cookies, provider consoles, arbitrary regional docs or hosts, endpoint category broadening, raw responses, pagination, polling, bulk operations, uploads, exports, writes, and administration are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Organization and administrator review required
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is callable until the exact Everlaw organization and Organization Admin authorize a least-privilege Relay integration and live acceptance boundary.

runtimeSupport.description: Everlaw remains visible for discovery, but no OpenClaw tools are callable before exact-organization authorization, administrator/security review, least-privilege design, and live acceptance.
Everlaw remains visible for discovery, but no Hermes tools are callable before exact-organization authorization, administrator/security review, least-privilege design, and live acceptance.

providerSetup.blocker: Everlaw publishes an API, but the public support material describes organization-level admin API keys and broad endpoint categories. Relay needs exact organization approval, deployment region, least-privilege endpoint permission selection, and a fixed identity-free authority contract before implementing any runtime tool.
providerSetup.nextAction: Obtain explicit approval from the exact Everlaw organization and Organization Admin. Define the approved region, API-key or OAuth model, endpoint permissions, fixed identity-free authority endpoint, token/key lifecycle, inactivity/rotation handling, audit obligations, response bounds, test project, disconnect behavior, and live acceptance before implementing any connector.

evidence.supports: Everlaw support documents Organization Admin API key creation, regional API docs, API keys equivalent to passwords, one-time key download, key revocation/disablement, OAuth2 availability, scope groups, and broad endpoint categories.
Everlaw describes e-discovery workflows from upload and processing through search, review, production, trial preparation, analytics, collaboration, and generative AI.
Everlaw describes processing, review, production, redaction, search, predictive coding, analytics, and document-review capabilities over sensitive discovery data.
Everlaw describes AWS-backed cloud e-discovery, legal hold, collection, review, GovCloud availability, and enterprise security posture.

securityNotes: No Everlaw organization, API key, OAuth grant, token, regional host, user, database, project, document, review work product, Deep Dive query, legal hold, billing, audit, or legal data was collected or tested.

The existence of a public Everlaw API does not establish Relay authorization for any customer organization, Organization Admin key, OAuth app, regional deployment, project, document corpus, legal hold, or review dataset.

Relay will not use Organization Admin API keys, passwords, browser sessions, cookies, arbitrary regional API docs, endpoint category broadening, raw API exploration, upload APIs, search APIs, or OAuth grants as a substitute for exact-organization approval.

All identity, organization, database, project, user, permission, document, source-file, metadata, search, review, AI, legal hold, billing, audit, upload, production, write, administration, raw API, pagination, bulk, and export operations remain unavailable.
